sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Preparing a plan
[[Cherit]] spies on the [[Silent Soldiers]] and reports on their moves to the team. To enter the volcano through the old lava tunnel that they're guarding, they set up a trap in the jungle to ward them off the entrance and then take them out with their powers and Titans before they can react to the news of magic being functional again. Meanwhile, [[Wind]] and [[Shauna]] order soldiers, who are trying to retrieve the amulet from lava pits in the volcano.

;Inside the volcano
The team's plan is successful, but with more guards coming, Dante orders [[Metagolem]] to block up the tunnel, leaving [[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]] outside to battle them out. Inside the volcano, [[Lok]] and [[Sophie]] spot Wind, Shauna and guards rummaging the lava pits. Perched on their ledge, they realize that the floor motif resembles the [[Amulet of Will]], and Sophie guesses that the amulet is hidden in the leftmost pit, which is where the red gem is placed on the real amulet.

;Defeating Wind and Shauna
While Montehue and Tersley keep fighting guards off outside, Dante, Lok, Sophie and Den swiftly take out Wind and Shauna with powers and Titans before they can react. While the Blood Spiral is in check, they go over possible ways to retrieve the amulet from the lava pit, without success. But as they let their guard down, Wind and Shauna strike back and invoke their powerful Titans.

;The lost daughter rises from red ashes
In the middle of her fight with Shauna, Sophie feels like something deep in the volcano is calling for her. Yet again, the team is unable to keep up with the sheer power of Wind and Shauna and is soon in a bad posture. Lok suddenly understands that the "lost daughter" mentioned by Nostradamus is none other than Sophie, and in last resort, she dives head first into the lava pit where the amulet lies. The volcano starts erupting and both the Huntik team and the Blood Spiral get out as fast as possible. Outside, they witness the legendary Titan of Rebirth [[Phoenix]] flying above the erupting volcano, alongside Sophie who is now bonded to it.

Back in Italy, the team scans Phoenix's amulet with a [[Cypherdex]]. Dante points out that it is most likely that Sophie was protected from the lava, rather than resurrected, but also notes that they are yet to know all the powers Phoenix might have. In a moment of calm, Lok tells Sophie that he always knew she would come out alive.

full_text:
The Huntik team joins Montehue and Tersly for a mission to recover the Casterwill Titan, Phoenix. But powers and Titans cannot be used because of the Lodestone, and the Blood Spirals have a head start. Lok destroys the Lodestone, and Dante plans to ambush the Spirals before they realize magic can be used again.

== Synopsis ==
The team continues on their mission with Montehue and Tersly. They come up with a plan to take out the Silent Soldiers guarding the volcano's entrance. While Montehue and Tersly hold off the guards, Dante, Lok, Den, and Sophie face off against Wind and Shauna. Sophie knows she must face her fears as the lava calls for her to dive in.

== Plot ==

Meanwhile, Wind and Shauna order soldiers, who are trying to retrieve the amulet from lava pits in the volcano.

;Inside the volcano
The team's plan is successful, but with more guards coming, Dante orders Metagolem to block up the tunnel, leaving Montehue and Tersly outside to battle them out. Inside the volcano, Lok and Sophie spot Wind, Shauna and guards rummaging the lava pits. Perched on their ledge, they realize that the floor motif resembles the Amulet of Will, and Sophie guesses that the amulet is hidden in the leftmost pit, which is where the red gem is placed on the real amulet.

;Defeating Wind and Shauna
While Montehue and Tersley keep fighting guards off outside, Dante, Lok, Sophie and Den swiftly take out Wind and Shauna with powers and Titans before they can react. While the Blood Spiral is in check, they go over possible ways to retrieve the amulet from the lava pit, without success. But as they let their guard down, Wind and Shauna strike back and invoke their powerful Titans.

;The lost daughter rises from red ashes
In the middle of her fight with Shauna, Sophie feels like something deep in the volcano is calling for her. Yet again, the team is unable to keep up with the sheer power of Wind and Shauna and is soon in a bad posture. Lok suddenly understands that the "lost daughter" mentioned by Nostradamus is none other than Sophie, and in last resort, she dives head first into the lava pit where the amulet lies. The volcano starts erupting and both the Huntik team and the Blood Spiral get out as fast as possible. Outside, they witness the legendary Titan of Rebirth Phoenix flying above the erupting volcano, alongside Sophie who is now bonded to it.

Back in Italy, the team scans Phoenix's amulet with a Cypherdex. Dante points out that it is most likely that Sophie was protected from the lava, rather than resurrected, but also notes that they are yet to know all the powers Phoenix might have.
